artists.name: 澄
artists.tagline: 風、雨、花——うつろうものの歌を、ほぼ週に一曲。
artists.tagline_en: Songs of things that pass — wind, rain, flowers — nearly one a week.

artists.name: 空想音色
artists.tagline: ささやき声とアコースティック・ギターで光と闇の間（あわい）を描くソロ・プロジェクト。最小限の言葉と残響で日常の静寂を照らす、淡く透きとおったミニマル・サウンドスケープ。
artists.tagline_en: A solo project drawing the half-light between darkness and day from a whispered voice and an acoustic guitar. Pale, translucent, minimal soundscapes, illuminating the stillness of ordinary days with the fewest possible words and the resonance they leave behind.
